description: List every check at a PR's current head — workflow runs, gates and commit statuses — with status, conclusion, whether branch protection requires it, and the run's log URL; plus each required check's state (passing / pending / failing / missing) and the merge gate's own CI verdict. Read-only. Returns {head_sha, total_count, check_runs, required, ci}.
